title: Agent Invocation Skipped Event
description: A dispatcher decided NOT to invoke an agent for a ticket event: a provider-event or phase guard missed, the owning agent is ineligible or fenced, or no agent owns the board. It is the only trace such a decision leaves, so a ticket nobody picked up is explainable from the bus.

reason.description: Human-readable reason the invocation was skipped.

skip_code.description: Machine-readable skip class. provider_event_guard and phase_guard are filters the workflow asked for; ineligible, invalid_policy and fenced are registry or manifest policy; no_route means no agent owns the board.

operation.description: Dispatcher operation that skipped, for example groomTicket or delegateTicket.

target_agent_id.description: Agent the ticket would have been addressed to, or null when no agent was resolved.

matched_by.description: How the target was resolved: by board id, by the <repo>-pm convention, or not at all.

context.description: The same ticket context an agent.invocation.start command would have carried, so a skip and a dispatch are filterable on the same paths.

reason.description: Invocation purpose, for example ticket-grooming or ticket-delegation. Not the skip reason.
